where: A home in Cambridge (Middlesex County’s government was abolished in 1997; cities levy the property tax).
input_label: Assessed value of your home (from the Assessor)
split_note: Each government’s share is one slice unless it publishes a debt split.
rollback_note: Massachusetts has no yearly no-raise rate; Proposition 2½ caps how much a city’s total levy can grow each year (2.5% plus new growth) unless voters approve an override. Cambridge’s FY2026 levy is about $172.9 million below its limit.
limits: The 3% Community Preservation Act surcharge on the bill isn’t included.
